limitations: Archive coverage is not a detection. No source classification or science-grade flux extraction is claimed.
Query centers use approximate propagated SIMBAD positions; annual parallax and binary orbital motion are not modeled.
Flags and wavelength comparisons are screening information, not a guarantee of valid photometry.
Deep-field collections and the all-sky cube are not downloaded; neither is required for the selected wide-survey prototype.
SOURCE and FULLSAMPLE bits are informational, not automatically rejected as bad data.
Reprojection and PSF matching are still required before interpreting image differences.
